rule: APPEND-ONLY (R6). Owner corrections 2026-07-29. v1 is NEVER used for anything (wrong starter attributions); grading uses v2 only.

c1_push_mass_WITHDRAWN.withdrawn_claim: 'their integer totals have no push mass'
c1_push_mass_WITHDRAWN.correction: The board incorporates integer pushes into EV; displayed Over/Under percentages are CONDITIONAL-ON-SETTLEMENT probabilities. Numeric support (owner): BAL-DET Under 8.0 at -125: conditional no-push EV = 0.589*(100/125) - 0.411 = +6.02%; reported +5.4% implies ~10% push mass (1 - 5.4/6.02 = 0.103).
c1_push_mass_WITHDRAWN.valid_residual_criticism: P(push) is not DISPLAYED and therefore cannot be audited directly.
c1_push_mass_WITHDRAWN.standing_rule: Any adopted implementation must display separate P(over), P(push), P(under).

c2_lineup_language_REPLACED.correct_term: TOP-NINE-VOLUME ROSTER PROXY — the board states no lineups were posted and each club's nine highest-volume hitters substitute. It does NOT test confirmed-lineup value.

c3_independence_WITHDRAWN.withdrawn_claim: 'two independent constructions confirm the BOS@ATH artifact'
c3_independence_WITHDRAWN.correction: The external total model is slate-scaled by 0.950 to match the market-average total -> market-anchored, NOT independent of the market. BOS@ATH remains a strong DIAGNOSTIC disagreement and the V13 R5 flag stands, but the cause is NOT confirmed.

c4_k_methodology_RECLASSIFIED.reason: The K line already embeds workload, pitcher skill, matchup and market judgment; applying log5 to it may double-count opponent information.
c4_k_methodology_RECLASSIFIED.prohibition: Do NOT import this design into the independent K engine.
permitted_future_benchmarks: separately sourced pitcher-outs line as workload proxy
the K line with NO independence claim on the resulting forecast
c4_k_methodology_RECLASSIFIED.observed_consequence: their Skubal projects OVER (+0.7, 9.16 vs 8.5) where our history-based E[K] says UNDER (-1.8) — the two methods are not measuring the same thing.

c5_market_provenance.reconciliation_attempt_not_assertion: View B of our frozen capture (PHI -170 / MIA +143) proportional-devigs to exactly 60.5/39.5.
